description: The image is a donut chart representing the distribution of "Stimulus Type," which is indicated by bold black text in the center of the ring. The chart features ten external text labels with corresponding percentages in parentheses, although only nine distinct colored slices are visually discernible. Moving clockwise from the top right, the largest slice is red and corresponds to a label obscured by a blurred grey box showing "(26.4%)". Continuing clockwise, a dark brown slice is labeled "Event Posting (6.6%)", followed by a mauve slice labeled "Organizational Report (7.7%)", and a dark blue slice for "Interview (8.8%)". An additional label for "Organizational Website (4.9%)" is positioned on the lower right but lacks a clearly corresponding distinct tenth slice. Continuing around the bottom and left, a light blue slice is labeled "Intra-agency news article (4.9%)", a large dark green slice is "External News Article (18.1%)", a small light green slice is "Email (2.7%)", a large yellow slice is "Press Release (18.7%)", and a very thin orange slice at the top left is "Social Media Post (1.1%)". The chart does not use a separate legend or place percentage labels inside the slices, nor are any segments exploded, offset, or ordered by size.
